_comment: Regression gates for scripts/rag_eval.py --check (k=4, demo embedder and extractive answerer, Cypress Harbor sample library, evals/golden/questions.jsonl). Each minimum is one point below the value measured when the credit-union golden set was introduced, rounded down. Raise them when retrieval or answering improves; never lower them to make a change pass. ACL leaks are a hard gate at 0.
